description: This Java source file defines the BaseAttributesService class, which implements attribute management functionalities such as find, save, and delete for entities within the Thingsboard platform. It interacts with data access objects and external services to handle attribute data.

classes.name: BaseAttributesService
classes.description: Implementation of AttributesService for managing entity attributes, including retrieval, saving, and deletion, with integration to external services and data access objects.

methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute value for an entity asynchronously.

methods.description: Retrieves multiple attribute values for an entity asynchronously.
